phase_name: Typed Authority Model Production Consumer Implementation
summary: Implemented the first production Typed Authority Model consumer, pcae authority inspect <path> [--json], exactly within TAMPC-001 v1.0's frozen scope per the Phase 137J implementation plan. Two new production modules: src/pcae/cltr/authority_inspection.py (orchestration -- package-owned Stage 3 resource resolution via pcae.schema_resources.cltr_cutover_root(), manifest/registry verification, family/version/identity resolution, schema validation, typed-model construction, lossless round-trip check, immutable InspectionObservation/InspectionFailure construction, provenance assembly) and src/pcae/commands/authority_inspect.py (CLI layer -- bounded artifact read, --json/human rendering, exit-code translation), plus one new authority inspect subparser group in src/pcae/cli.py. All sixteen Stage 3 record families supported. One documented, narrowly-justified deviation from the 137J plan: relies on frozen=True alone for immutability (Python 3.9's dataclasses rejects a redundant explicit __setattr__/__delattr__ override on a frozen dataclass); TAMPC-REQ-078's actual requirement (ordinary mutation rejected) is still met via dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError. Verified via wheel install and sdist install, each run from a fresh isolated virtual environment and a working directory outside the repository checkout, confirming no repository-root dependency. Repaired 24 pre-existing Stage 3 phase tests (136Z through 136AV) whose 'no production module imports the authority package' guards were correct before this phase but are now the expected, contract-authorized exception this phase introduces; added a narrow, by-filename exception to each rather than relaxing them broadly. Also authorized cltr->schema_runtime and commands->schema_runtime in .pcae/policy.toml's architecture dependency rules, matching TAMPC-001's frozen dependency chain. Also discovered and separately documented (not repaired, out of TAMPC-001's scope) a pre-existing self-comparison bug in pcae session bootstrap's readiness classifier; queued in tasks/TODO.md and docs/FINDING_BOOTSTRAP_READINESS_STALE_TASK_SELF_COMPARISON.md. Runtime remained Observed / observe / unavailable throughout. See docs/PHASE_137K_TYPED_AUTHORITY_MODEL_PRODUCTION_CONSUMER_IMPLEMENTATION.md.
tests_added_or_updated: New: tests/test_authority_inspect_137k.py (64 tests, all passing) -- freshly authored fixtures per TAMPC-REQ-168, covering all sixteen families, malformed-artifact/unknown-family/version/identity/schema/model failure categories, registry_failure/manifest_failure via monkeypatched Stage 3 exceptions, immutability, determinism, provenance field presence, CLI Stage-1 boundary, CLI rendering/exit codes/registration via live subprocess invocation, forbidden-import static AST scan, exact public-API-surface match, lifecycle/runtime neutrality, no-side-effect check. Updated: 24 pre-existing tests across 23 files (tests/test_cltr_authority_136{z,aa,ab,ac,ad,af,ag,ah,ai,aj,ak,al,am,an,ao,ap,aq,ar,as,at,au,av}*.py) to add a narrow, explicitly-commented exception for authority_inspection.py/authority_inspect.py to their pre-137K 'no production module imports the authority package' guards.
